visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with dark brown hair sits in a black stroller on a paved outdoor walkway. He is wearing a white Dodgers baseball jersey and blue shorts, looking upwards with a wide-eyed and expectant facial expression. The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting the texture of his jersey and the details of the stroller straps. (2) The scene cuts to the hands and torso of a male vendor at an ice cream stand. He wears a striped shirt and is using a long metal rod to vigorously stir and knead a thick mass of white ice cream inside a large wooden barrel. The motion is repetitive and creates a distinct physical presence in the frame. (3) The vendor presents a yellow ice cream cone attached to the long metal rod to the baby. The baby reaches out with both hands, his eyes following the cone with intense focus. The vendor playfully pulls the rod back just as the baby tries to grasp it, initiating a classic street-performance interaction. (4) A woman wearing a blue Dodgers jersey stands behind the stroller, smiling and looking down at the child. The toddler laughs heartily, revealing several small teeth, and continues to reach for the ice cream as the vendor swings it in a circular motion around the child's reach. (5) After several attempts, the baby is finally allowed to take a bite of the ice cream. The vendor holds the cone steady while the toddler leans forward with his mouth open. Subsequent shots show the baby sitting back with white cream smeared around his mouth, looking satisfied and calm.
